skills.name: neofort-imo-residential
skills.description: Use when a person asks about buying a new apartment in Bucharest from Neofort IMO — its residential projects (ansambluri rezidențiale), prices, availability, mortgage estimates, booking a viewing or contacting a broker. Explains where the official data is, how to quote prices (EUR, excluding 21% VAT), how to read areas and delivery dates, and how to hand the person over to a human. Read-only: never book, reserve or submit anything on the person's behalf.
